purpose: Deterministic widget selection policy for Phase 4. Chooses widget count, shape, component, and variant from semantic content types before layout placement.

globalRules.rule: Select semantic content types before selecting widget count, shape, component, variant, or position.
Apply strict rectangular template overrides before generic widget selection.
Do not use music_control, reminder, timer_rectangular, or checklist_full_face templates for another content type.
Only workout, timer, heart_rate, iot_control, and weather may render as circular widgets. All other content types must render as rectangular widgets.

selectionSequence.rule: Rank candidate content types by usefulness to the current context before deciding how many widgets to render.
Choose a renderable composition from the ranked candidates instead of assuming the top three content types can all fit.
Choose circular or rectangular rendering for each candidate according to circular eligibility, strict template rules, density, controls, and context needs.
Apply composition caps after shape selection: all-circular layouts may render up to three widgets; rectangular-present layouts may render at most two widgets total; checklist renders alone.
Emit only the selected widgets that fit the final legal composition, and log omitted or deferred content types.

circularEligibility.rule: Circular widgets are only legal for compact metric or status content. Eligibility does not force circular rendering; each eligible content type may still choose rectangular rendering when the context needs more detail or controls.
circularEligibility.rectangularOnlyRule: Every content type not listed in allowedContentTypes is rectangular-only. If no strict rectangular template exists yet, the content type must wait for generated rectangular composition support instead of being forced into a circular widget.

circularSelectionDelegation.rule: For content types in circularEligibility.allowedContentTypes, choose the circular component, property variant, and size by applying circular-widget-catalog.json, circular-widget-visual-specs.json, and watch-face-generation-rules.md. Do not hardcode content-type-to-component mappings in this policy.

allCircular.rule: When every rendered widget is circular, the layout may render up to three widgets.

rectangularPresent.rule: When at least one rendered widget is rectangular, the layout may render at most two widgets total. The second widget may be circular or rectangular.

checklistOnly.rule: Checklist uses checklist_full_face and must be the only rendered widget.

music_control.selectionReason: Playback controls require the preserved music_control template.

reminder.selectionReason: Reminder content and completion affordance require the preserved reminder template.

checklist.selectionReason: Checklist rows require the full-face checklist template and cannot share the face with other widgets.

allowedCircular.useWhen: Countdown is the only visible timer need and controls are not required.

timer.selectionReason: Timer may be compact as a circular close_gauge, but if rectangular it must use timer_rectangular.

generativeContentRules.rule: For content types outside strictTemplateRules, choose circular widgets only when the content type is listed in circularEligibility.allowedContentTypes. All circular component, variant, and size decisions must be made by applying circular-widget-catalog.json, circular-widget-visual-specs.json, and watch-face-generation-rules.md. All other generative content types require rectangular generated compositions in a later phase.

Reminder is a strict rectangular template content type.
Timer controls or detail fields make rectangular rendering useful; timer_rectangular is mandatory when rectangular.
Weather remains compact as precipitation chance.
